scope: Matched Policy updates31-100: 14 complete 5:1:1 cycles, with epoch30 retained as the first left endpoint.

source.access: CPU only sqlite mode=ro; stopped databases; no runtime imports/torch/GPU/remote writes
source.projection: Only synchronized_epoch_completed records30..100; integer event id/ts_ns and exact JSON epoch/global/rank/phase-duration fields. No publication/owner/request reconstruction.

definitions.cycle_wall_seconds: (epoch[end].ts_ns - epoch[start-1].ts_ns)/1e9, starts31,36,...,96; each cycle contains5 Policy,1 World,1 Reward updates.
definitions.sync_seconds: Sum recorded controller sync_seconds inside each5epoch cycle, host wall span.
definitions.known_measurement_exclusion: 31..100 avoids baseline capture14/15 and CPU25, and conservatively avoids IPC lineage observation16..25. This does not assert all profiler/workload effects eliminated.

limitations: This compact projection independently reproduces cycle-wall, phase sums and the headline only; it does not include publication timing, inference traces, checkpoint tensors or full-run claims.
Observed bundle changes include Policy/World IPC, Ray64->328GiB, warmup500->100/20 and lineage telemetry; this is not an isolated IPC causal A/B.
Train/sync fields are controller host wall durations; not SM Active/Occupancy, GPU kernel time or physical bandwidth.
Throughput is a completed5:1:1 update rate, not Policy-only speed or learning-quality/time-to-target improvement.
